text: へやからでると　つうしんが　おわりますが　よろしいですか？

structure.jp: つうしんが　おわりますが

patterns.name: 〜と
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that when this happens, the next thing follows. へやからでると = 'if/when you leave the room'.

patterns.name: 〜が
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a clause softly connects it to what follows, like 'but'. おわりますが = 'it will end, but…'.
